headline: When truck drivers said "enough": from blockades to fuel-less pumps, the protests Portugal has not forgotten
summary: Truck drivers are protesting fuel prices in Portugal, putting heavy vehicles back on the roads. The action raises questions about how far transport dissent can go when operators consider driving economically unviable.
why: Road haulage carries most of the goods in Portugal, so fuel costs and transport protests affect supply chains and inflation.
